order: Read the serializer pointer from manager+0x08 and the sorted range from serializer+0x24, +0x28 and the tag byte from serializer+0x38.
Store the incoming key word into the local key word and call 0x00555a20 with begin, end, the local key address, and the tag byte.
Clamp the result: end when the result equals end, end when the key is unsigned-below the slot value, otherwise the slot address itself.
Return false when the manager gate byte at +0x24 is nonzero. The gate is evaluated after the search, not before it.
Call 0x00554020 with the sorted set window in ECX, a local result record as the out parameter, and the incoming argument slot as the key; read the inserted byte from result+0x04.
Return false when the inserted byte is zero. A nonzero byte continues and is also the eventual return value.
When the clamped slot equals end, acquire the notification sink with 0x00883860 and, if it is nonzero, call its vtable slot +0x14 with the constant 0x05c6930e, the key address, and a zero tail.

Acquire the event queue with 0x0061df20; when nonzero, zero the two 16-bit words of the 0x18-byte event argument at +0x12 and +0x14, construct it with 0x00427fd0 from the key, post it with 0x0061fdb0 and the constant 0x01edc82b0, and call 0x0093db80 with a zero tail when the argument flag byte at +0x10 carries bit 0x04.
Call 0x006754d0 with the manager in ECX and discard the result.
mechanics.status_boundaries: The inserted byte is tested with TEST AL,AL, so every nonzero value continues and is returned as true; only zero stops. Values 0x01, 0x02 and 0x80 behave identically.
mechanics.stack_aliasing: The local key word at ESP-relative -0x1c is written with the key before the search and is then reused by 0x00554020 as the eight-byte out record, whose position dword overwrites the stored key. Every later use of the key therefore reads the incoming argument slot at ESP+0x04 rather than the local. The model keeps the key parameter addressable for the whole body.
mechanics.undefined_stack_content: Only the 16-bit words at event argument offsets +0x12 and +0x14 are provably zeroed. The remaining 0x14 bytes of the event argument, including the flag word at +0x10, are whatever the frame already held. The model zero-initializes the whole record so the sequence is deterministic; the ports own every field the target then reads.
mechanics.key_identity: The single incoming stack word is forwarded unchanged to 0x00554020, to the notification vtable call, to 0x00427fd0, and to 0x0061fdb0 through the constructed argument.
mechanics.domain_separation: The notification path (0x00883860 and its vtable slot) is a UI/communication boundary, the 0x0061df20 and 0x0061fdb0 pair is a separate queued communication boundary, and 0x006754d0 resolves a Simulator type and calls serializer vtable slot +0x10, which is a persistence boundary. The target performs no serialization, no record write, and no mission-manager access of its own.
mechanics.event_boundary: No award, unlock, reward, or progression side effect is performed. The only writes the target performs itself are the two 16-bit zero stores of the stack event argument.
mechanics.no_null_guard: Neither 0x0061fdb0's result nor the queue is validated beyond the acquire-time zero test, and the 0x006754d0 result is discarded.
